description: A Perl script for parsing and managing kernel configuration files, including functions for loading, comparing, adding, subtracting, and diffing configurations, as well as parsing expressions and printing configurations.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration value based on certain conditions.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads configuration from a file into a hash.

methods.name: config_and
methods.description: Computes the intersection of two configurations.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Combines two configurations, with optional modification.
